title: cargo-crumbkit/audit-report/v1
description: The report of one audit of a tool for places that should use something crumbkit offers, which the "Audit a tool" job of cargo crumbkit's skill writes.

repository.description: The repository that was audited, such as its path or its owner/name.

since.description: The starting commit of a catch-up audit, which judged only the files changed since it, or null for a full audit.

crumbkit_version.description: The crumbkit version that Cargo.lock pins, or the commit that a git source pins.

outcome.description: skipped when no criterion could be judged, fail when the report holds a finding, and pass otherwise.

files_read.description: The number of files that the audit read.

findings.description: One finding per symbol and criterion, in no particular order.

criterion.description: The id of the criterion that the place fails, such as typed-recovery.

severity.description: The severity that the skill's Severity section gives the finding.

file.description: The file that holds the symbol, relative to the repository's root. A finding that spans two places takes the file and symbol that sort first.

symbol.description: The function, type or enum that holds the places, such as BooksError::recovery.

places.description: Every place of the finding within the symbol, each as file:line.

text.description: What is wrong and the proposed change.

proposals.description: The proposals for crumbkit itself: each hand-written mechanism that repeats across two or more tools or crates and that no affordance covers, under the criterion crumbkit-gap. A proposal never makes the outcome fail.

text.description: The mechanism, and what crumbkit could offer in its place.

places.description: The places of the mechanism in each tool or crate, each as file:line.

newer_affordances.description: The affordances newer than the pinned version, which the tool can use after an upgrade.

affordance.description: The affordance as AFFORDANCES.md names it.

since.description: The first version with the affordance.

not_judged.description: The criteria that the audit could not judge, with the reason, such as Reads that are absent.

unverified.description: The findings with no file:line to cite, which count in no outcome.
